name: session-successor
description: When a session runs low on context it stops at a logical point, writes a handoff, starts its successor (name-2, name-3, ...) at max effort and tells its peer sessions the new name. With the companion JetBrains plugin, Session Successor on JetBrains Marketplace (https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/35944-session-successor), the successor opens in a new terminal tab.

threshold.title: Hand off below (% context left)
threshold.description: The session hands off once less than this share of its context window remains.

effort.title: Successor effort
effort.description: Effort level the successor session starts with.

worktree_guard.title: Worktree guard for successors
worktree_guard.description: off: the successor edits the repo in place, like the session it replaces. on: keep Claude Code's guard, which blocks edits in a background session until it moves into a git worktree.

context_window.title: Context window (tokens)
context_window.description: Size of your model's context window, used to compute how much is left.
